Hey, we launched Goethe, because deploying models on hardware you control end-to-end is pain in the ass.

Goethe is like Vercel, but for AI models and hardware. It manages your models and hardware you point it and runs corresponding optimal inference. -- install it -- deploy any model you want -- get an API you can use with any client securely
title: Show HN: Goethe – The infrastructure for self-hosted AI
